root_cause.text: The mtk_jpeg_release() function frees the context structure (ctx) without first canceling any pending or running jpeg_work workqueue item, allowing a use-after-free when the work handler accesses the freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `cancel_work_sync(&ctx->jpeg_work);` before the mutex lock and subsequent `kfree(ctx)` in mtk_jpeg_release(), directly addressing the missing cleanup that led to the described race condition. The CVE description details the race where CPU 0 (release) calls kfree(ctx) while CPU 1 (workqueue) still accesses ctx.

intent_record.what: Added a call to `cancel_work_sync(&ctx->jpeg_work);` at the beginning of `mtk_jpeg_release`, before mutex acquisition and resource cleanup.
intent_record.how: Ensures that any pending or running workqueue job associated with the JPEG context is completed or removed before the context resources are released, preventing potential use-after-free or race conditions.
